items.title: Mindspright Legal acts on Kheria Autocomp IPO
items.summary: Kheria Autocomp Limited has listed for an initial public offering of 45,98,400 equity shares aggregating up-to ₹46.44 crore. Mindspright Legal advised Kheria Autocomp on this IPO.
